notes: Binary assets were inventoried by metadata; they were not downloaded or visually inspected for this planning task.
Vendored joystick source was inspected separately; generated distributions do not create additional game features.
The root wawa-vfx gitlink is recorded, not claimed as a separately audited repository.
An upstream README task or dependency is not evidence of wired gameplay.

wawaGitlinkProvenance.limitation: The exact gitlink resolves here and its pinned manifest declares MIT. Its complete tree has no licence file. Three copied blobs are identical and three differ; review those differences and retain an applicable notice before vendoring new source.
wawaGitlinkProvenance.phase1Disposition: No new Wawa source or dependency will be vendored. Use the audited implementation as a capability reference and extend the existing original bounded instanced-effect adapters with original code. This avoids relying on an unverified licence text and avoids importing its parallel Zustand store. Original retained model/decoder notices remain applicable.

assetInventorySummary.scope: Media entries across both pinned source trees, not installed assets; retained installed files separately have SHA-256 hashes and embedded texture metadata.
